title: A Message in Notes

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Well, well, well, you're back... to bother someone. Just kidding! Though that feels like a catchy tune. Musta heard it somewhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, well, well, you're back... to bother someone. Just kidding! Though that feels like a catchy tune. Musta heard it somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I found AG's compendium.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found AG's compendium.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: You did! That's wicked. Can I take a look?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You did! That's wicked. Can I take a look?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here you go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here you go.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Bossin'. This is rad. Like the best song I've ever heard.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bossin'. This is rad. Like the best song I've ever heard.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Speaking of music. Any idea what the notes mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Speaking of music. Any idea what the notes mean?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Speaking of music. Any idea what the notes mean?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Speaking of music. Any idea what the notes mean?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Okay, let me look. Alright, if we find the painting... here we go... yup! Here are the notes. Okay, let me look at the jukebox again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yeah! Okay, let me look. Alright, if we find the painting... here we go... yup! Here are the notes. Okay, let me look at the jukebox again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you think it is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think it is?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you think it is?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you think it is?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Well, let's see. If we take these... then add them here... and play this... OH! I know this. It's the start to his song Woman in Red and Rain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, let's see. If we take these... then add them here... and play this... OH! I know this. It's the start to his song Woman in Red and Rain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Woman in Red in Rain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woman in Red in Rain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's clues to his own song?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's clues to his own song?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's clues to his own song?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's clues to his own song?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Yeah, but it's what's in the song that matters. It's the intro bit, and the music notes here end right when the lyrics start.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, but it's what's in the song that matters. It's the intro bit, and the music notes here end right when the lyrics start.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are the lyrics?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are the lyrics?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: I saw here there, from my lanai. Looking at me like life was a lie. But in her beauty and her eyes I saw, that this is all perfect afterall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I saw here there, from my lanai. Looking at me like life was a lie. But in her beauty and her eyes I saw, that this is all perfect afterall.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's touching.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's touching.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: If the Original AG was anything, he was appreciative of what he had. Something we all could do a bit more of. Hey, do you... um, do you mind if I hang onto this? Maybe look through it some more?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If the Original AG was anything, he was appreciative of what he had. Something we all could do a bit more of. Hey, do you... um, do you mind if I hang onto this? Maybe look through it some more?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course. Thanks for helping me find the vibes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. Thanks for helping me find the vibes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Of course. Thanks for helping me find the vibes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Of course. Thanks for helping me find the vibes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually, I'd like to hang onto it for a bit. See his work and all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually, I'd like to hang onto it for a bit. See his work and all.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Actually, I'd like to hang onto it for a bit. See his work and all.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Actually, I'd like to hang onto it for a bit. See his work and all.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Makes sense. I'm glad you found the vibes my friend. Make sure to keep your ear to the waves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Makes sense. I'm glad you found the vibes my friend. Make sure to keep your ear to the waves.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ahh! You're the best. I knew you'd find them. Keep your ear to the waves my friend. I'll see you at the next show.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahh! You're the best. I knew you'd find them. Keep your ear to the waves my friend. I'll see you at the next show.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How can you hear that when you're only looking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can you hear that when you're only looking?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How can you hear that when you're only looking?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How can you hear that when you're only looking?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: What kind of question is that? If you can read the notes, you can hear them. Can you hear the word "tree" when you read the letters?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of question is that? If you can read the notes, you can hear them. Can you hear the word "tree" when you read the letters?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any ideas what they mean? The notes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any ideas what they mean? The notes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Any ideas what they mean? The notes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Any ideas what they mean? The notes.
